notes: 2MASS J17563584-2152290: the individual note at T:p3-b4 prints '2NASS J17563584-2152290'; the 2MASS designation is taken from Table 1 at T:p2-b0 and I:p2-b0. 2MASS J19352291+4626156: T:p4-b0 truncates the 2MASS name to '2MASS J19352291+462656'; Table 1 at T:p2-b0 and I:p2-b0 gives J19352291+4626156. 2MASS J02274456+6140299 and 2MASS J02475329+6044285: T:p4-b4 and T:p4-b5 say further study is needed to establish whether they are HVS, while the explicit group statement at T:p2-b2 covers all seventeen; they are retained as candidates. 2MASS J23470671+6311571: T:p4-b2 reports possible Galactic cluster membership, and 2MASS J00504461+5824384: T:p4-b3 describes it as a red giant in an open cluster; the authors still include both in the HVS sample at T:p2-b2.

2MASS J17500025-1542221: Table 1 reports Galactic coordinates l and b and a total proper motion mu, not equatorial RA/Dec or separate proper-motion components, so those quantities are not extracted (T:p2-b0). It also lists U, V, W velocity components but no total Galactic rest-frame speed, so no total speed is extracted.

2MASS J18213211-1740598: For 2MASS J18213211-1740598, Table 1 reports Galactic coordinates l=13.8 deg and b=-1.6 deg, a single total proper-motion magnitude mu=8.99 mas/yr, and velocity components U=-691, V=-170, W=20 km/s plus Vt=334 km/s (T:p2-b0; I:p2-b0). These are not equatorial RA/Dec, individual proper-motion components, or a total Galactic rest-frame speed, so those quantities were not extracted. No parallax, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probabilities are reported for this star.

2MASS J15003649-5529145: Table 1 reports a single total proper-motion magnitude (mu = 6.68 mas/yr) rather than separate equatorial proper-motion components, so no proper_motion_ra or proper_motion_dec values are retained. The U, V, W, and Vt entries are Galactic velocity components and tangential speed, not the requested total Galactic rest-frame speed.

2MASS J17322853-3342336: The paper gives Galactic l and b rather than equatorial RA/Dec, and lists only a total proper motion mu rather than separate RA/Dec components, so ra, dec, proper_motion_ra, and proper_motion_dec are omitted. U, V, W and Vt are reported as velocity components/tangential speed, not a total Galactic-rest-frame speed, so galactic_rest_frame_velocity is omitted. No galactocentric radius or bound/unbound probability is reported for this star.

2MASS J17502866-3242362: The target is 2MASS J17502866-3242362 (Gaia DR3 4043485523412935040). Table 1 gives only the total proper motion (mu = 2.31 mas/yr), Galactic U, V, W velocity components, and tangential velocity Vt; it does not give equatorial proper-motion components or a total Galactic-rest-frame speed. No right ascension, declination, parallax, or galactocentric radius is reported for this star.

2MASS J17563584-2152290: The target notes identify 2MASS J17563584-2152290 as a long period variable candidate, but the note prints the name as "2NASS J17563584-2152290" (T:p3-b4); the Gaia DR3 identifier and coordinates/table row identify it as the target. Table 1 gives a single total proper motion mu = 9.57 mas/yr, not separate RA/Dec proper-motion components, so no proper_motion_ra/proper_motion_dec values were extracted. Table 1's U, V, W are Galactic velocity components and Vt is tangential velocity; no total three-dimensional Galactic rest-frame speed is reported, so galactic_rest_frame_velocity was not extracted.

2MASS J18084725-1403252: T:p2-b0 reports Galactic l and b, a single total proper-motion column mu, and U, V, W, and Vt components, but does not report equatorial RA/Dec, separate proper-motion components, parallax, Galactocentric radius, a total Galactic rest-frame speed, or bound/unbound probability for this star; those quantities were therefore not extracted.

2MASS J18271007-1907365: The paper's Table 1 (T:p2-b0; I:p2-b0) lists Galactic l, b and a single total proper motion mu rather than equatorial RA/Dec coordinates or proper-motion components; no galactocentric radius or total Galactic-rest-frame speed is reported. U, V, W, and Vt are not converted or combined here.

2MASS J18443216+0253312: T:p2-b0 reports Galactic coordinates (l=34.7 deg, b=2.9 deg), total proper motion (mu=6.54 mas/yr), U, V, W components, and tangential velocity Vt=236 km/sec for this star, but no equatorial RA/Dec, proper-motion RA/Dec components, total Galactic rest-frame speed, galactocentric radius, parallax, or bound/unbound probability. The text at T:p3-b7 gives Teff, log g, and [Fe/H] but no additional quantities listed above.

2MASS J19283045+1312303: The paper's Table 1 (T:p2-b0, I:p2-b0) gives only Galactic coordinates l=48.9 deg and b=-2.0 deg, not equatorial right ascension/declination, so no ra/dec values are reported. The single column 'mu' = 6.02 mas/yr is an undifferentiated total proper motion, not separate RA/Dec components, so no proper-motion components are extracted. The table's U, V, W (-528, -605, 28 km/sec) and Vt (157 km/sec) are heliocentric velocity components/tangential velocity, not a total Galactic rest-frame speed or galactocentric radius, so those quantities are not extracted. The star is described in T:p3-b8 as a long period (240.137737 days) variable candidate with Teff = 3265K, log g = 0.361, [Fe/H] = 0.35; no astrometric values beyond those above are given.

2MASS J07383691+3212208: Table 1 (T:p2-b0) reports a single total proper motion, mu = 112.05 mas/yr, not separate right-ascension and declination components, so proper_motion_ra and proper_motion_dec are not extracted. The table also reports U, V, W, and Vt, but no total Galactic-rest-frame speed, so galactic_rest_frame_velocity is not extracted.

2MASS J19352291+4626156: The text at T:p4-b0 identifies this star as "2MASS J19352291+462656", while Table 1 at T:p2-b0/I:p2-b0 and the Gaia DR3 identifier give 2MASS J19352291+4626156; I treated these as the same target. Table 1 gives only a total proper motion (mu = 3.78 mas/yr), not separate RA/Dec proper-motion components, so no proper-motion component was extracted. The table also gives U, V, W and Vt, but does not report a total Galactic rest-frame speed, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability; these were not calculated or converted.

2MASS J11220124+5309490: Table 1 reports a single total proper-motion magnitude μ = 4.78 mas/yr, not separate right-ascension and declination components, so no proper_motion_ra or proper_motion_dec value is assigned. The reported U, V, and W are individual velocity components, not a total Galactic-rest-frame speed; no galactocentric radius or bound/unbound probability is reported.

2MASS J23470671+6311571: The target row in T:p2-b0 gives mu = 3.37 mas/yr, but this is a total proper-motion value and is not separated into equatorial RA/Dec components; no equatorial coordinates or parallax are reported. U, V, W, and Vt are velocity components/tangential speed, not a reported total Galactic-rest-frame speed, so no galactic_rest_frame_velocity value was extracted.

2MASS J00504461+5824384: For 2MASS J00504461+5824384, Table 1 (T:p2-b0; I:p2-b0) reports total proper motion μ = 2.12 mas/yr but not separate equatorial proper-motion components, and gives Galactic l,b rather than equatorial RA/Dec; therefore ra, dec, proper_motion_ra, and proper_motion_dec were not assigned. The table also reports U, V, W velocity components and Vt, but no total Galactic-rest-frame speed or bound/unbound probability is reported.

2MASS J02274456+6140299: The paper does not report equatorial RA/Dec for this star; Table 1 gives Galactic l and b. The Table 1 "mu" value of 0.65 mas/yr is a single total proper-motion entry, not separate RA/Dec components, so it is not assigned to proper_motion_ra or proper_motion_dec. U, V, W, and Vt are listed, but no total Galactic-rest-frame speed is reported. No parallax, Galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability is reported for this star. The 2MASS designation is treated as an identifier rather than an explicitly tabulated coordinate value.

2MASS J02475329+6044285: Table 1 reports Galactic coordinates and total proper motion rather than equatorial RA/Dec or separate proper-motion components. It also gives U, V, W, and Vt, but no total Galactic rest-frame speed. No parallax or bound/unbound probability is reported. Locations: T:p2-b0, I:p2-b0.
